description:
Job Description: 

  

 Develop, train, and evaluate computer-vision models for autonomous-driving perception tasks, applying both classical computer-vision methods and deep-learning approaches. Design and conduct controlled machine-learning experiments, develop quantitative evaluation metrics, and analyze results to improve model and dataset quality. Develop and maintain pipelines for scene mining, annotation-task generation, dataset construction, data processing, model training, and validation. Develop software tools for analyzing model behavior and visualizing annotations, datasets, predictions, and evaluation results. Develop, integrate, and maintain computer-vision components within offline, simulation, and online perception systems, including multicamera and panoramic camera configurations, and resolve image-projection, geometric-transformation, and data-synchronization issues arising across those systems. Review scientific literature in computer vision and deep learning and prototype and evaluate relevant models and algorithms for autonomous-driving perception problems. Collaborate with related engineering teams to investigate data, annotation, infrastructure, and cross-component integration issues.

 



 Requirements: 

  

 Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Mathematics, Informatics, or a closely related field. A foreign equivalent degree is accepted.  Position requires 36 months of experience as a research engineer, machine-learning engineer, or position in a related field of computer vision or machine-learning model development. 

 The position further requires the following: 

 At least one year of that experience must have involved developing camera-based perception systems for autonomous vehicles or advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS). 

 Two years of the required professional experience must have involved developing and evaluating deep-learning-based computer-vision models. 

 Two years of the required professional experience must have involved designing or conducting machine-learning experiments and evaluating model performance. 

 Experience with classical computer vision, image processing, object detection, segmentation, and tracking. 

 Experience developing data-processing, annotation, dataset-generation, training, or validation pipelines for machine learning. 

 Professional software-development experience in Python and C++. 

 Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow. 

 Experience with distributed or large-scale data processing using PySpark or a comparable framework. 

 Experience with workflow orchestration for data-processing or model-training pipelines using Argo Workflows or a comparable system. 

 Experience developing in containerized environments using Docker or a comparable technology. 

 Experience using SQL to query and prepare data for analysis, model training, or evaluation. 

 Experience with distributed version control using Git or a comparable system.
 Candidates are required to be authorized to work in the U.S. The employer is not offering relocation, sponsorship, and remote work options are not available. 

 Avride is an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities to ensure they have equal access to employment opportunities. Avride complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), if you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with the application or hiring process, or to perform the essential functions of a job, please email jobs@avride.ai .
